title: China-to-Tanzania Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: Electrical Safety and 230 V / 50 Hz Grid
rows.target_requirement: Tanzania operates a 230 V, 50 Hz single-phase supply. While the 50 Hz frequency matches China, the rated voltage and plug/socket system differ from China domestic 220/380 V practice, so corded tools, chargers, and external power supplies must be rated and verified for 230 V. Electrical safety is assessed against the TBS-adopted IEC 62841 series for the tool, with the charger or external PSU verified for the 230 V supply. Conformity is demonstrated through the TBS PVoC route, not by self-declaration alone.
target_standards: TZS national standard adopting IEC 62841 series （general and particular requirements for electric motor-operated hand-held, transportable, and lawn/garden tools）
TBS PVoC verification against the adopted electrical safety standard
Tanzania 230 V / 50 Hz supply and national plug/socket configuration for corded tools, chargers, and external PSUs
rows.china_equivalent: China files often use the GB/T 3883 series for tool electrical safety, rated for the China domestic 220/380 V supply, plus separate charger standards where applicable. These reports should be mapped to the TBS-adopted IEC 62841 requirements and re-checked for 230 V rating, supply configuration, and the destination plug system rather than treated as automatic TBS evidence.
china_standards: China charger safety standards where applicable
rows.gap: The common gap is shipping tools and chargers rated and tested only for the China 220/380 V domestic supply and plug system, then assuming TBS acceptance. The Tanzania file must confirm a 230 V rating, the correct plug/socket configuration, and electrical-safety evidence mapped to the TBS-adopted IEC 62841 standard and verified through PVoC.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation: TBS conformity for electrical safety of in-scope power tools, applying the TZS-adopted IEC 62841 series and verified through PVoC. The 230 V / 50 Hz rating and national plug system are practical placement conditions, not optional.
target.zh: 强制法律义务：受管制电动工具的电气安全须符合 TBS 符合性要求，适用 TZS 采用的 IEC 62841 系列并经 PVoC 验证。230 V / 50 Hz 额定及国家插头制式是实际投放条件，并非可选项。
target.zht: 強制法律義務：受管制電動工具的電氣安全須符合 TBS 符合性要求，適用 TZS 採用的 IEC 62841 系列並經 PVoC 驗證。230 V / 50 Hz 額定及國家插頭制式是實際投放條件，並非可選項。

cn.en: China domestic evidence commonly uses the GB/T 3883 series and charger-specific standards where applicable, rated for the 220/380 V supply.
cn.zh: 中国境内证据通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列及适用的充电器专项标准，按 220/380 V 供电额定。
cn.zht: 中國境內證據通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列及適用的充電器專項標準，按 220/380 V 供電額定。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Conditionally non-compliant until corded tools, chargers, and external PSUs are confirmed for the Tanzania 230 V / 50 Hz supply and plug system, and electrical-safety evidence is mapped to the TBS-adopted IEC 62841 standard and verified through PVoC. GB/T 3883 reports rated only for the China supply should not be presented as automatic TBS evidence.

rows.requirement: EMC and TCRA Radio Approval for Cordless Tools
rows.target_requirement: Motor-driven tools, electronic speed controllers, chargers, and power supplies must meet electromagnetic compatibility limits under the TBS-adopted EMC standards （commonly IEC/CISPR-based texts）, verified through the PVoC route. Separately, any cordless tool with a radio function such as wireless connectivity needs type approval from the Tanzania Communications Regulatory Authority （TCRA） before it can be placed on the market. EMC conformity and TCRA radio approval are distinct obligations.
target_standards: TZS national standards adopting IEC/CISPR-based EMC requirements, verified via TBS PVoC
Tanzania Communications Regulatory Authority （TCRA） type approval for radio-enabled cordless tools
rows.china_equivalent: China compliance packages may include EMC reports alongside GB/T 3883 safety reports, and SRRC-type radio approval for the China market. Test limits, configuration, worst-case operating modes, charger inclusion, and any radio module approval still need TBS-specific EMC mapping and a separate TCRA submission for Tanzania.
china_standards: China EMC standards and test reports where applicable
China SRRC radio type approval where applicable
rows.gap: Two frequent gaps: an EMC report that tests only the bare tool and omits the charger, battery pack, or controller variants; and treating China SRRC radio approval as sufficient for a cordless tool with wireless features. Tanzania requires EMC evidence mapped to the TBS-adopted standard and a separate TCRA type approval for the radio function.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation: TBS-adopted EMC requirements via PVoC for in-scope apparatus, and TCRA type approval for radio-enabled cordless tools. A non-radio corded or cordless tool needs EMC conformity but not TCRA approval.
target.zh: 强制法律义务：适用设备须经 PVoC 符合 TBS 采用的 EMC 要求，带无线电功能的无绳工具须取得 TCRA 型号核准。无无线电功能的有线或无绳工具需 EMC 符合性，但无需 TCRA 批准。
target.zht: 強制法律義務：適用設備須經 PVoC 符合 TBS 採用的 EMC 要求，帶無線電功能的無繩工具須取得 TCRA 型號核准。無無線電功能的有線或無繩工具需 EMC 符合性，但無需 TCRA 批准。

cn.en: China domestic files may include EMC evidence and SRRC radio approval, but Tanzania acceptance depends on scope, limits, configuration, and a separate TCRA submission.
cn.zh: 中国境内文件可包含 EMC 证据和 SRRC 无线电批准，但坦桑尼亚接受性取决于范围、限值、配置以及单独的 TCRA 申报。
cn.zht: 中國境內文件可包含 EMC 證據和 SRRC 無線電批准，但坦尚尼亞接受性取決於範圍、限值、配置以及單獨的 TCRA 申報。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Tanzania-ready until EMC evidence covers the actual marketed tool system and is mapped to the TBS-adopted EMC standard via PVoC, and any radio-enabled cordless tool holds separate TCRA type approval. China SRRC approval does not substitute for TCRA.

rows.requirement: TBS Market Access, PVoC and Certificate of Conformity
rows.target_requirement: Electric and cordless power tools placed on the Tanzania market fall under the Tanzania Bureau of Standards （TBS） mandatory conformity framework. Regulated goods must pass Pre-Export Verification of Conformity （PVoC） before shipment, obtain a Certificate of Conformity for clearance at the port of entry such as Dar es Salaam, and bear the TBS mark. TBS national standards commonly adopt IEC/EN texts, including the IEC 62841 series for hand-held, transportable, and lawn/garden electric tools. The legal obligation is the TBS conformity route; the adopted standard is the technical content.
target_standards: Tanzania Bureau of Standards （TBS） mandatory conformity framework and TBS mark
TBS Pre-Export Verification of Conformity （PVoC） scheme with Certificate of Conformity at port of entry
TZS national standards adopting IEC 62841 series for hand-held, transportable, and lawn/garden electric tools
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files commonly reference the GB/T 3883 series for hand-held motor-operated electric tools, transportable tools, and lawn and garden machinery, with CCC where applicable. GB/T 3883 evidence does not replace the TBS PVoC inspection, the Certificate of Conformity, or the right to use the TBS mark.
rows.gap: A China domestic safety report is not enough for Tanzania placement. The exporter needs PVoC processing before shipment, a Certificate of Conformity for customs clearance, TBS-mapped test evidence against the adopted IEC 62841 standard, and TBS mark authorization. GB/T 3883 reports may need restating or retesting to the TBS-adopted standard and PVoC route.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation: TBS conformity framework with mandatory PVoC, Certificate of Conformity, and TBS mark for regulated power tools. The TBS-adopted IEC 62841 series supplies the technical requirements applied through this route.
target.zh: 强制法律义务：TBS 符合性框架，对受管制电动工具实行强制 PVoC、符合性证书和 TBS 标志。TBS 采用的 IEC 62841 系列提供经由该路径适用的技术要求。
target.zht: 強制法律義務：TBS 符合性框架，對受管制電動工具實行強制 PVoC、符合性證書和 TBS 標誌。TBS 採用的 IEC 62841 系列提供經由該路徑適用的技術要求。

cn.en: Mandatory China domestic baseline commonly uses GB/T 3883 series for in-scope power tools, with CCC where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内强制基线通常对适用电动工具采用 GB/T 3883 系列，并在适用时配合 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內強制基線通常對適用電動工具採用 GB/T 3883 系列，並在適用時配合 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Tanzania-ready as-is if the product file only contains GB/T 3883 evidence. PVoC processing, a Certificate of Conformity, TBS mark authorization, and test evidence mapped to the TBS-adopted IEC 62841 standard are required before clearance at the port of entry.

rows.requirement: Noise: No Outdoor Product-Marking Regime; Occupational Framework Only
rows.target_requirement: Tanzania does not operate an equivalent of the EU outdoor-noise product-marking directive, so there is no general guaranteed-sound-power-level marking obligation on imported power tools as a placement condition. Noise is instead addressed mainly through the occupational health and safety framework administered by OSHA Tanzania （Occupational Safety and Health Authority）, which targets workplace noise exposure for employers and users rather than a product label. Any noise data declared should be presented honestly as informational and not as a Tanzania conformity mark.
target_standards: OSHA Tanzania （Occupational Safety and Health Authority） occupational noise-exposure framework （workplace, not product marking）
No Tanzania equivalent to EU Directive 2000/14/EC outdoor-noise product marking
rows.china_equivalent: China GB/T 3883 safety evidence usually focuses on electrical and mechanical hazards and may include declared noise/vibration figures, but does not constitute a Tanzania product-noise mark. There is no destination outdoor-noise label to map to, so the comparison is best framed as an occupational exposure consideration rather than a missing product certification.
china_standards: China declared noise/vibration data where applicable
rows.gap: Honest assessment: there is no Tanzania product-noise marking gap to close because the destination has no such product regime. The real consideration is occupational: employers and users in Tanzania remain subject to OSHA workplace noise-exposure duties, so declared tool noise data is useful for risk management but is not a placement requirement.

target.en: No mandatory product-noise marking obligation for imported power tools in Tanzania. OSHA Tanzania occupational noise-exposure duties apply to workplaces and users, not as a product conformity mark at import.
target.zh: 坦桑尼亚对进口电动工具无强制产品噪声标识义务。OSHA Tanzania 职业噪声暴露义务适用于工作场所和使用者，而非进口时的产品符合性标志。
target.zht: 坦尚尼亞對進口電動工具無強制產品噪聲標識義務。OSHA Tanzania 職業噪聲暴露義務適用於工作場所和使用者，而非進口時的產品符合性標誌。

cn.en: GB/T 3883 evidence may include declared noise data but does not create a product-noise certification in either market.
cn.zh: GB/T 3883 证据可包含声明的噪声数据，但在任一市场均不构成产品噪声认证。
cn.zht: GB/T 3883 證據可包含聲明的噪聲數據，但在任一市場均不構成產品噪聲認證。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No Tanzania product-noise marking is required for power tools, so this is not a placement blocker. Treat declared noise data as occupational-safety information under the OSHA Tanzania framework rather than as a missing product certification.

source.publisher: OSHA Tanzania （Occupational Safety and Health Authority）

rows.target_requirement: Tanzania does not operate a standalone RoHS-style restricted-substances marking regime equivalent to the EU directive as a general placement condition for power tools. Material and chemical safety is handled mainly through TBS standards for the product and the Government Chemist Laboratory Authority （GCLA） chemicals-management framework where hazardous substances are involved. Importers should confirm whether the specific tool, charger, or accessory triggers any TBS material requirement or GCLA chemical control, rather than assuming an EU-style RoHS declaration is required or sufficient.
target_standards: TBS standards covering product material and safety aspects
Government Chemist Laboratory Authority （GCLA） chemicals-management framework where hazardous substances apply
rows.china_equivalent: China RoHS （SJ/T 11363 type marking） and GB/T 3883 evidence can support material and safety review. For Tanzania, this material data is informational support rather than a directly mapped mandatory declaration, because there is no general Tanzania RoHS placement mark to satisfy.
rows.gap: Honest assessment: the gap is usually not a missing Tanzania RoHS mark, since no general regime exists. The real check is whether specific materials or chemicals in the tool, charger, or accessories trigger a TBS material requirement or GCLA chemical control, and confirming the China material data covers the actual exported configuration.

target.en: No general mandatory RoHS-style product mark in Tanzania for power tools. TBS material requirements and GCLA chemical controls apply only where specific substances or product standards trigger them.
target.zh: 坦桑尼亚对电动工具无一般强制 RoHS 式产品标志。TBS 材料要求和 GCLA 化学管制仅在特定物质或产品标准触发时适用。
target.zht: 坦尚尼亞對電動工具無一般強制 RoHS 式產品標誌。TBS 材料要求和 GCLA 化學管制僅在特定物質或產品標準觸發時適用。

cn.en: China RoHS or GB/T 3883 material evidence supports review but is not a Tanzania placement declaration by itself.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 或 GB/T 3883 材料证据支持审查，但本身不构成坦桑尼亚投放声明。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 或 GB/T 3883 材料證據支援審查，但本身不構成坦尚尼亞投放聲明。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No general Tanzania RoHS-style mark is required for power tools, so this is not a standalone blocker. Confirm whether any specific material or chemical triggers a TBS material requirement or GCLA control, and keep China material data as supporting evidence.

rows.target_requirement: For cordless power tools, the lithium battery pack and charger are part of the imported product and are assessed through the TBS conformity framework, typically against TBS-adopted IEC battery and charger safety standards, verified via PVoC. Tanzania does not operate an EU-style Battery Regulation with battery passport, due-diligence, and removability mandates; the core obligation is battery and charger safety conformity plus the lithium-battery transport rules that apply to the shipment.
target_standards: TBS-adopted IEC battery and charger safety standards, verified through PVoC
Applicable lithium-battery transport rules for the shipment （for example UN 38.3 transport testing）
rows.china_equivalent: China tool files often treat the battery pack as an accessory tested with the tool under GB/T 3883, plus separate lithium-battery safety （for example GB 31241） and transport （UN 38.3） evidence. For Tanzania this can support TBS battery/charger safety review, but it must be mapped to the TBS-adopted standards and confirmed through PVoC rather than assumed accepted.
china_standards: China lithium battery safety （for example GB 31241） and transport （UN 38.3） evidence where applicable
rows.gap: Honest assessment: there is no separate EU-style battery-passport or economic-operator gap to close for Tanzania. The real gap is ensuring the battery pack and charger safety evidence is mapped to the TBS-adopted standards and accepted through PVoC, and that lithium-battery transport documentation is in order for the shipment.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation: TBS conformity for battery and charger safety of cordless tools via PVoC, plus lithium-battery transport rules for shipment. No EU-style Battery Regulation passport or removability mandate applies in Tanzania.
target.zh: 强制法律义务：无绳工具的电池和充电器安全须经 PVoC 符合 TBS 要求，并须遵守货物的锂电池运输规则。坦桑尼亚不适用欧盟式电池法规护照或可拆卸性强制要求。
target.zht: 強制法律義務：無繩工具的電池和充電器安全須經 PVoC 符合 TBS 要求，並須遵守貨物的鋰電池運輸規則。坦尚尼亞不適用歐盟式電池法規護照或可拆卸性強制要求。

cn.en: China tool and battery evidence supports review but must be mapped to TBS-adopted standards and accepted through PVoC for Tanzania.
cn.zh: 中国工具和电池证据支持审查，但须映射到 TBS 采用的标准并经 PVoC 接受方适用于坦桑尼亚。
cn.zht: 中國工具和電池證據支援審查，但須映射到 TBS 採用的標準並經 PVoC 接受方適用於坦尚尼亞。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Tanzania-ready for cordless tools until the battery pack and charger safety evidence is mapped to the TBS-adopted standards and accepted through PVoC, with lithium-battery transport documentation in order. No EU-style battery-passport obligation applies.
